title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is analysing the stratification at infinity of the stack M̂^!_{1,2} (genus 1, marked-point set I={a,b}). It has two boundary divisors, D_○ (loop graph G_0) and D_– (segment graph G_1), and two codimension-2 points P_0 and P_1. This page treats the loop divisor D_0 = D_○.

G_0 is one genus-0 vertex carrying the two legs a,b and a loop. Its two half-edges form a 2-element set Ã^!_0, so M_{G_0} ≅ M_{0,4}, the moduli of 4 points on P^1 labelled by the 4-element set I ⊔ Ã^!_0. The compactification M̂_{G_0} ≅ M̄_{0,4} ≅ P^1_J, where J is the 3-element set of partitions of I ⊔ Ã^!_0 into two pairs. (Grothendieck writes 'type (1,2)'; type (2,2) is meant, since these partitions index the boundary points of M̄_{0,4}.)

With Grothendieck's intrinsic description, eq. (84):
- J has a canonical point ε_1 = {I, Ã^!_0}.
- The other two partitions pair each leg with a half-edge, i.e. they are the bijections I → Ã^!_0.
- These form J' = I ∧_{Z/2} Ã^!_0, a Z/2-torsor-like set: J = {ε_1} ⊔ J'.

So P^1_J is the twisted compactification of G_m ∧_{±1} J'. Here ε_1 sits at 1, the two points of J' sit at 0 and ∞, and S_{J'} ≅ Z/2 acts by z ↦ 1/z, by transport of structure (85).

Action of the symmetry groups:
- The group Γ^!_0 = Ker(Aut G_0 → S_I) ≅ Z/2 swaps the branches of the loop and acts through S_{J'}.
- S_I also acts through S_{J'}. Hence S_I acts trivially on M̂_{D_0}: swapping a and b is absorbed by the branch swap. This reflects the curve involution x ↦ a+b−x.

Boundary points of M̂_{D_0}:
- the orbit J' (the points 0, ∞) gives P_0;
- ε_1 (the point 1) gives P_1.

Quotient (86): taking invariants of Z[z,1/z] under z ↦ 1/z gives Z[T] with T = z + 1/z. Removing the image of the third cusp z=1 (T=2), the coarse space is M_{D_0} ≅ A^1_Z \ {T=2} = Spec Z[T, 1/(T−2)].

Compactification (87): M̂_{D_0} ≅ P^1_Z with a Z/2 orbifold ('signature 2') structure along the section T=2. The next page confirms the placements: P_0 ↔ T=∞ and P_1 ↔ T=2. This is the standard explicit description of the normalized loop boundary divisor of M̄_{1,2}, as a step toward understanding how the boundary strata of M̄_{g,ν} glue.
errors: Spec Z[T]_{(T-2)} is written as a localization at the prime (T-2); the intended ring is Z[T,1/(T-2)], i.e. inverting T-2.
'partition de type (1,2)' should be type (2,2) (partitions of a 4-element set into two pairs); probably a slip.

Possible omission: z ↦ 1/z has two fixed points on M̄_{0,4}, z=1 (boundary, T=2) and z=-1 (interior, T=-2). The quotient stack therefore also has a Z/2 orbifold point at T=-2 inside M_{D_0}, which (87) as transcribed does not mention (unless the stated signature locus is meant to include it).
Over F_2 the two fixed points z=±1 coincide (T=2=-2) and the Z/2 action is wildly ramified; a 'signature 2 along section 2' description over Spec Z needs care at p=2. Not addressed here.

ideas.what: Intrinsic description of M̄_{0,4} as P^1 indexed by the 3 pair-partitions of a 4-set, with a canonical point and a twisted torus G_m ∧_{±1} J' for the torsor J' = I ∧_{Z/2} Ã
ideas.modern_name: M̄_{0,4} ≅ P^1 with boundary points indexed by partitions; twisted forms of G_m
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore (Knudsen, Keel for the M̄_{0,n} boundary)
ideas.where_published: Spirit close to Esquisse d'un programme (M_{0,4}, M_{1,1} as building blocks of the Teichmüller tower)

ideas.what: Normalization of the irreducible (loop) boundary divisor of M̄_{1,2} as [M̄_{0,4}/(Z/2)], with coarse space P^1_Z via T = z + 1/z
ideas.modern_name: boundary divisor Δ_irr of M̄_{1,2}, gluing/clutching map ξ_irr

ideas.what: S_I acts trivially on the loop divisor of M_{1,2} because the leg swap is absorbed by the branch swap
ideas.modern_name: hyperelliptic-type involution x ↦ a+b−x on M_{1,2}

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but standard explicit computation of the boundary divisor Δ_irr of M̄_{1,2} over Z. The torsor-style intrinsic bookkeeping is characteristic of Grothendieck but not new mathematics. It contains minor slips and a possible omitted orbifold point.
transcription_corrections: 'Spec Z[T]_{(T-2)}' should be read as Z[T] with T-2 inverted.
'la compactifié de G_m^1 ∧_{±1} J'' — the subscript appears as ±1 (i.e. Z/2), consistent with J' = I ∧_{Z/2} Ã^!_0.
In (85) the second line reads P^1_{({ε_1} ⊔ J')}; 'ε' is ε_1.
The marginal note 'ε_1 correspondant au point 1' belongs to the description of P^1_J (ε_1 ↦ 1, J' ↦ {0,∞}).
'J^!' in the line about the two points at infinity should be J' (the trajectory/orbit J', giving P_0).
